name: Revealing Flash · Death · Cold
primary:
Affects the creature you aim at:
• Highlights everyone you can harm within 35 blocks, visible through walls for 45 s
• Withering: −0.5 ❤ per second for 6 s
• Life drain: 1 ❤ damage, you heal 0.52 ❤
• Cold 80: extinguishes and slows, freezes for 4 s at 100 built-up cold (×2.5 on wet); puddles freeze
• Slowness III for 9 s
self_description:
On you:
• Highlights everyone you can harm within 46 blocks, visible through walls for 45 s
• Withering: −0.5 ❤ per second for 4.5 s
• Cold 25: extinguishes and slows, freezes for 4 s at 100 built-up cold (×2.5 on wet); puddles freeze
